A single 3×3 conv sees 9 pixels. Stack t.zh: 单个 3×3 卷积只看到 9 个像素。堆叠三层之后，一个深层特征便能看到一个 7×7 的区域。若以步长 2 堆叠，其深度便可触及图像的各个角落。拖动深度滑块，观察它的增长。
A single 3×3 conv sees 9 pixels. Stack t.src: A single 3×3 conv sees 9 pixels. Stack three, and a deep feature sees a 7×7 region. Stack with stride 2, and depth reaches the corners of the image. Drag the depth slider to watch it grow.

@@T0@@~7 min@@T1@@@@T2@@Deep Learning ·.zh: @@T0@@约 7 分钟@@T1@@@@T2@@深度学习 · CNN · 感受野@@T3@@

Convolution is local by design. That's t.zh: 卷积在设计中就是局部的。这正是其要义所在 —— 它编码了「邻近像素需一并考虑」这一先验。但单个 3×3 卷积核只能看到 9 个像素。那么，CNN 究竟如何识别出一整只狗？
Convolution is local by design. That's t.src: Convolution is local by design. That's the whole point — it encodes a prior that nearby pixels matter together. But a single 3×3 kernel can only see 9 pixels. So how does a CNN ever recognize a whole dog?

The answer is that @@T0@@receptive field.zh: 答案在于@@T0@@感受野@@T1@@随深度增长。每一层的神经元看到的是上一层输出的一个局部区域，而该输出本身又由更前一层的局部区域构建而来。经过若干层之后，单个激活值便依赖于输入中很大的一片区域。
The answer is that @@T0@@receptive field.src: The answer is that receptive field grows with depth. Each layer's neuron sees a patch of the previous layer's output, which was itself built from a patch of the layer before that. After a few layers, a single activation depends on a large region of the input.

@@T0@@RF size: @@T1@@7@@T2@@@@T3@@\n.src: RF size: 7 Equivalent single kernel: 7×7 Stacked params (C→C): 27 C² Single-kernel params: 49 C²

The formula is simple: each stride-1 con.zh: 公式很简单：每个核尺寸为 K、步长为 1 的卷积都会给感受野增加 (K−1)。步长为 2 的卷积会@@T0@@成倍提升@@T1@@增长速度。空洞卷积引入间隔，无需任何额外参数即可扩大感受野。
The formula is simple: each stride-1 con.src: The formula is simple: each stride-1 conv of kernel size K adds (K−1) to the receptive field. Stride-2 convs multiply the growth rate. Dilated convs add gaps, expanding RF without any extra params.

Why stack 3×3 instead of one 7×7?.zh: 为何堆叠 3×3，而非使用单个 7×7？

Three stacked 3×3 convolutions and a sin.zh: 三个堆叠的 3×3 卷积与单个 7×7 卷积具有相同的感受野。但堆叠的 3×3 在两个方面胜出：
Three stacked 3×3 convolutions and a sin.src: Three stacked 3×3 convolutions and a single 7×7 conv have the same receptive field. But stacked 3×3 wins on two fronts:

@@T0@@Non-linearities@@T1@@ — three ReLU.zh: @@T0@@非线性@@T1@@ —— 堆叠层之间有三次 ReLU，而 7×7 之后仅有一次。以更少的参数获得表达力更强的函数类。
@@T0@@Non-linearities@@T1@@ — three ReLU.src: Non-linearities — three ReLUs between stacks vs one after the 7×7. A more expressive function class for fewer parameters.

This is the VGG insight (Simonyan &amp;.zh: 这就是 VGG 的洞见（Simonyan 与 Zisserman，2014）。自 2014 年起，它成为每一个 CNN 架构的默认做法。
This is the VGG insight (Simonyan &amp;.src: This is the VGG insight (Simonyan & Zisserman 2014). It became the default for every CNN architecture from 2014 onward.

@@T0@@The twist.@@T1@@ Theoretical RF gr.zh: @@T0@@转折之处。@@T1@@ 理论感受野是线性增长的。而有效感受野（Luo 等，2016）则呈中心加权的高斯形态 —— 靠近中心的像素贡献远大于边缘像素。这正是注意力机制（第 12 讲）得以流行的原因：它从第 1 层起便具有真正均匀的全局感受野。
@@T0@@The twist.@@T1@@ Theoretical RF gr.src: The twist. Theoretical RF grows linearly. Effective RF (Luo et al. 2016) is a center-weighted Gaussian — pixels near the centre contribute far more than edge pixels. This is why attention (L12) caught on: it has truly uniform global RF from layer 1.

meta.title: 感受野增长实验
meta.tagline: 堆叠卷积，观察深层特征的影响范围如何扩散
meta.summary: 卷积是局部的 —— 单个 3×3 卷积核只能看到 9 个像素。但只要将它们堆叠起来，感受野便会急剧扩张。拖动深度滑块，在同核堆叠与混合核堆叠之间切换，看清究竟有哪些输入像素会影响某个深层特征。VGG「堆叠 3×3 卷积」的洞见由此变得一目了然。
highlights: 从一个 3×3 卷积开始 —— 感受野宽度为 3 个像素。
堆叠三个 3×3 卷积 —— 感受野增长到 7×7，而参数却少于单个 7×7。
对比步长 1、步长 2 与空洞卷积 —— 深度相同，感受野增长却大相径庭。
实时查看参数数量计算：3×(3·3·C²) = 27C² 与 1×(7·7·C²) = 49C² 的对比。
预览有效感受野 —— 实际呈现的中心加权高斯形态。
